name: Death to Eerick
source:
Death lurks in every corner and it’s after Eerick.

Can you keep him alive through the day…

The choices you make decide the fate of poor Eerick! 

[From [url=https://aneananas.itch.io/death-to-eerick]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
死亡潜伏在每个角落，它追随埃里克。

你能让他活一整天吗？

你所做的选择决定了可怜的埃里克的命运！

[来自[url=https://aneananas.itch.io/death-to-eerick]Itch.io[/url]]
